decisions.rationale: 1024 threads/block: each thread handles 4096/1024=4 elements. Max threads per block on Ampere, giving maximum intra-block parallelism for the two-pass reduction (sum-of-squares then normalize). Fewer blocks (1024 total, ~34/SM) but higher parallelism per block — worth measuring as the reduction tree is shallower with more warps (32 warps vs 16).
